notes: V7.1.12: RISK METRICS & STATS finally populates (TOTAL RETURN, SHARPE, MAX DD, WIN RATE, VOLATILITY, AVG DAILY). The bots never wrote a separate *_snapshots.jsonl file — they only wrote the trade log with portfolio_value baked into each entry — so load_snapshots() always returned empty and every risk card stayed on '—'. The function now synthesises the time series from the existing trade log (supports both the LONG/SHORT schema with portfolio_before/after and DAY's portfolio.value schema). No bot-side changes needed; existing data populates immediately on first launch.
